title: Inzwi Rinobva Mugomba Rakadzika
intro: Nyaya yemwoyo murefu netsitsi dzisingaperi dzaMwari inobuda muQuran. Mutumwa akatumwa kuguta guru, asi vanhu vavo vakaramba yambiro vakaramba chokwadi. Mukugumbuka, mweya uyu wakaenda - kuti uedzwe negungwa rine hasha ndokumedzwa murima guru. Kubva mudumbu rerima, chikumbiro chekuzvininipisa chakasimuka, uye Mwari ane Ngoni akapindura. Ndiani mweya uyu wakabuda wakashanduka, une vanhu vanodarika zana rezviuru?
clues: Ndakatumwa semuyambiri kuguta guru rine vagari vakatsauka kubva munzira yekutenda.
Ndakadana vanhu vangu kuti vauye kuchokwadi kakawanda, asi vakaseka uye vakaramba shoko rangu.
Ndakavasiya ndakatsamwa vasati vapihwa mvumo, ndikaenda kugungwa guru.
Dutu guru rakamuka, ndikakandwa mumvura — ndikazomedzwa nechinhu chikuru chegungwa.

Mukati merima guru — pasi pegungwa, mudumbu rechisikwa, uye pasi pegungwa rakadzika — ndakadanidzira ndichiti: 'Hakuna mumwe mwari kunze kwenyu; kukudzwa ngakuve kwamuri; ndaiva pakati pevaiti vezvakaipa.'
Allah vakandinunura kubva pakadzika, uye pandakadzoka, vanhu vangu vanopfuura zviuru zana vakanga vagamuchira chokwadi.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
